organization_business_hours_times.name: organization_business_hours_times
organization_business_hours_times.value: ("organization_business_hours"."is_open" and "organization_business_hours"."opens_at" is not null and "organization_business_hours"."closes_at" is not null and "organization_business_hours"."closes_at" > "organization_business_hours"."opens_at") or (not "organization_business_hours"."is_open" and "organization_business_hours"."opens_at" is null and "organization_business_hours"."closes_at" is null)

customers_json_shapes.name: customers_json_shapes
customers_json_shapes.value: ("customers"."maintenance_plan" is null or jsonb_typeof("customers"."maintenance_plan") = 'object') and ("customers"."last_service" is null or jsonb_typeof("customers"."last_service") = 'object') and ("customers"."upcoming" is null or jsonb_typeof("customers"."upcoming") = 'object')

services_pricing_shape.name: services_pricing_shape
services_pricing_shape.value:
("services"."pricing_model" = 'free-assessment' and "services"."price_amount" is null and "services"."price_label" is null)
        or ("services"."pricing_model" = 'fixed-price' and coalesce("services"."price_amount" > 0, false) and "services"."price_label" is null)
        or ("services"."pricing_model" = 'diagnostic-fee' and coalesce("services"."price_amount" > 0, false) and coalesce(char_length(btrim("services"."price_label")) > 0, false))
